description: All-Father Odin is chief among the gods of Valhalla, and the most respected among them. Along with his wife Frigg, he is the undisputed ruler of the realm, credited with the creation of the fierce and valorous Valkyries.Many tales speak of Odin's exploits as a mighty warrior—how his legendary spear Gungnir can utterly destroy any creature. But few know of the spear's secret power of creation, which the All-Father harnessed to form all manners of life. His goal was to create the ultimate protector of Valhalla, an infallible guardian to last all time.Behind the All-Father's commendable appearance, however, lies a deep-rooted anxiety. Odin fears nothing except an old prophecy speaking of a cataclysmic event known as Ragnarok, for even the gods must tremble at a fate unknown...
summon: Valhalla is under my protection!None shall threaten its sanctity.
fusion: Should Ragnarok come upon us,I fear we may have no recourse.But we must always stand ready...
evolution: The weight of all the worlds rests upon my shoulders...
